ads_enabled.description: Master switch: false disables ALL ads for every user (Free, Premium, Pro).

push_notifications_enabled.description: When false, the app skips requesting notification permission.

ad_native_android.description: AdMob native ad unit ID (Android). Replace with production ID before release.

ad_banner_android.description: AdMob banner unit ID (Android), including the collapsible main-screen banner.

paywall_close_delay_seconds.description: Seconds before the paywall close button appears.

ad_app_open_splash.description: App open ad on the splash screen.

ad_banner_splash.description: Banner ad at the bottom of the splash screen.

ad_native_language.description: Native ad on the language screen.

ad_native_htu.description: Native ad at the bottom of the how-to-use screens.

ad_banner_business_name.description: Banner ad on the business name screen.

ad_banner_main.description: Collapsible banner ad on the main screen.

ad_interstitial_main.description: Interstitial on the main screen: first click, then every 3 clicks.

ad_banner_create_invoice.description: Banner ad on the create invoice screen.

ad_interstitial_use_template.description: Interstitial on the Use Template button.

ad_interstitial_open_invoice.description: Interstitial when Watch Ad is tapped on Open Invoice.

ad_interstitial_share_pdf.description: Interstitial when Watch Ad is tapped on Share PDF.

ad_interstitial_print.description: Interstitial when Watch Ad is tapped on Print.

ad_interstitial_pdf.description: Interstitial when Watch Ad is tapped on the PDF button.

ad_interstitial_custom_invoice.description: Interstitial after generating a custom invoice.

ad_interstitial_generate_ai.description: Interstitial on Generate in Create with AI.

ad_interstitial_ocr_create.description: Interstitial on Create Invoice in Scan with OCR.

ad_app_open_foreground.description: App open ad when the app returns to the foreground.

ad_app_open_media_return.description: App open ad when returning from the camera or gallery.

ad_native_settings.description: Small native ad after a few settings tiles.

ad_rewarded_template.description: Rewarded ad that unlocks one premium template for the current app session.

ad_native_splash.description: Large native ad on the splash screen.

ad_native_onboarding.description: Large native ad on the how-to-use screens.

ad_native_google.description: Large native ad on the Google sign-in screen.

ad_native_business_name.description: Large native ad on the business name screen.

ad_interstitial_nav_screens.description: Interstitial when opening Clients, Items, or Language. Keep off.

ad_interstitial_save_invoice.description: Interstitial after saving a new invoice.

ad_interstitial_preview_back.description: Interstitial when leaving preview for Home.

ad_rewarded_ai_credit.description: Rewarded ad that grants one extra AI credit.

ad_rewarded_extra_invoice.description: Rewarded ad that grants one extra invoice today.

ad_native_home_list.description: Native card in the home invoice list.

interstitial_min_interval_sec.description: Minimum seconds between any two interstitials.

interstitial_max_per_session.description: Interstitial cap for one app session.

app_open_min_background_sec.description: Ignore resume app-open ads unless the app was backgrounded at least this long.

ads_grace_until_first_invoice.description: No interstitial or app-open ad until the user saves their first invoice.

ad_config_version.description: Logged as an Analytics user property when this config is active.

ad_banner_screen.description: Floating banner at the bottom of screens other than splash and language.

free_daily_invoice_limit.description: Max invoices Free users can create per calendar day (-1 = unlimited).

premium_daily_invoice_limit.description: Max invoices Premium users can create per calendar day (-1 = unlimited). Pro is always unlimited in app.

watermark_footer_free.description: Free PDF shares include a Created with Invoice GO footer. Pro never shows it.

review_prompt_enabled.description: Play in-app review after the second PDF share or the first paid invoice, never in the first session.

weekly_summary_enabled.description: Monday morning local notification when unpaid invoices exist.

min_supported_version.description: When this is above the installed versionCode, the Play update is immediate.

announcement_id.description: Banner id. Change it to show the announcement again after a dismiss.

announcement_title.description: Home banner title. Empty hides the banner.

market_defaults_json.description: Placeholder payment hints by country code. Not saved until the user types them.

ad_rewarded_watermark.description: Rewarded ad that removes the free PDF footer from one invoice.

invoice_link_enabled.description: Hosted invoice links stay off. Image share does not use this.
